about: Teresa R. Byers, an attorney with Ogden Murphy Wallace PLLC in Seattle, Washington, helps clients address Estate Planning & Probate situations. She also helps clients with Estate & Trust Litigation concerns.

Teresa Byers was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that she is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. She was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2026.
